jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: About SuperPlane SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it. The Role We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end. This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range. At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day. We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build. What We Are Looking For You are genuinely full-stack. Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy. You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast. You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you. You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack. You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery. You want ownership, not a narrow lane. You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big. How To Apply We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source. Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged. When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward. jobs.title: A Book of Your Own
jobs.description: Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission. It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you. I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes. It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages. There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book. Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own? Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject? Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book. Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book. jobs.title: This IS Your Dream Job
jobs.description: Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday? The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing. Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment. Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. If you loved laying out the college newspaper, but hated the organizational aspects such as chasing people down to get their content in on time, then that tells you something about the types of activities that work for you. STEP 3: Envision your ideal job â and list the tasks that it would encompass. What basic skills involved in your ideal job could start working on today? This could be something simple â if your ideal job is to be in charge of all written communication for your organization, an area you could start working on immediately is your writing skills. Even if your current writing skills are pretty good, there is always room to work towards a higher level of achievement. STEP 4: Now take the list of tasks and activities from steps 1 & 2 above, along with the list of skills from step 3, and group them into functions related to your job that you could concentrate on. (For example, if you are a financial analyst, but you find the grind of financial reports tedious, but you love creating charts and graphs and putting together presentations that visually demonstrate trends â your tasks and activities list could include âcreating graphs & chartsâ, and one skill that could be on your list is â Enhance MS Excel charting & graphing skillsâ . STEP 5: Conduct some research into the training available out there that would help you to enhance the skills you outlined in step 3. This could involve a number of options â anything from volunteering with an organization in a capacity where you could practice your skills, to taking webinars, intensive workshops, certificate programs, or working toward a degree. STEP 6: Using the information you gathered in step 5 above, get started with the training program(s) that will meet your individual needs. Remember that you can start small and fine-tune your training plan as you go along. You can also mix and match various training components â it doesnât have to be a straight path, as long as it gets you to where you want to go. This position involves working on the dock to ensure the proper mooring, securing, and release of ships, while maintaining safety and operational standards. (Regularly performed by ship crew) Ship and Dock Safety Maintain safety protocols during mooring procedures, ensuring that all tasks are performed in accordance with safety regulations. Communication and Coordination Communicate effectively with other team members on board and shore-based personnel. Gangway Inspections & Maintenance: Inspect gangway components for wear, corrosion, proper tension, secure connections, and smooth operation to ensure safe pedestrian access and functionality. Fenders: Conduct visual inspections of pier fenders and associated hardware to identify cracks, deformation, excessive wear, or damage caused by vessel contact, and report deficiencies as needed. Mooring Bollards: Regularly inspect mooring bollards for structural integrity, including corrosion, cracks, loose anchor bolts, foundation stress, and coating condition, to ensure safe vessel mooring. Stanchions & Pier Fixtures: Inspect stanchions and associated components for corrosion, damage, misalignment, or instability, ensuring they remain secure and serviceable. Ropes: Inspect ropes for wear, fraying, or damage, and verify they are properly positioned and suitable for continued use. Cleaning Equipment Operation: Safely inspect, operate, and maintain cleaning equipment, including scrubbers and pressure washers, ensuring proper use, cleaning, and storage after each operation. jobs.title: Program & Events Coordinator
jobs.description: About the LSPA: The LSP Association (LSPA) is a non-profit association for Massachusetts Licensed Site Professionals (LSPs) and other related environmental practitioners who work on behalf of property owners, operators, and other involved parties to assess and cleanup oil and hazardous materials (OHM) released to the environment. LSPs are licensed by the Commonwealth to oversee this work and, since 1993, over 40,000 contaminated properties have been brought into regulatory compliance. The LSPA's mission is to support our membership in achieving and maintaining a high standard of practice in the assessment and remediation of contaminated sites in Massachusetts and New England. The LSPA provides technical and educational resources to our membership in the form of programming, networking events, committees, and resources. The LSPA also serves as an advocate to the profession with MassDEP, the LSP Board of Registration, and the state legislature, and as a resource to the public. Job Description: The Program & Events Coordinator plays a critical role in the success of the LSPA and serves as a primary point of contact for our members, volunteers, and sponsors. This individual is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the association's educational programs and networking events, administering the sponsorship program, and providing customer service support. Success in this position means delivering high-quality member experiences, maintaining strong relationships with volunteers and sponsors, and ensuring the smooth administration of our continuing education program. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. This individual enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with volunteers, board members, speakers, sponsors, and staff. Key Responsibilities: Educational Programs : Coordinate, plan, and manage programs and speakers for all LSPA courses, membership meetings, emerging professional events, the Annual Fall Party, and the Environmental Symposium. The LSPA hosts one to three events per month with 25-250 people in attendance. Approximately 65% of programming is hosted virtually. Content creation is performed in conjunction with input from the Executive Director, Committee Chairs, Education Committee, and Board of Directors. Event Logistics: For in-person events, source event venues and help facilitate contracts; plan food and beverage, room set-up, and audiovisual needs; reconcile venue bills; and serve as the point of contact on-site. For virtual programs, setup and run the virtual meeting platform, monitor attendance and engagement, create moderator scripts and slides, and train speakers on how to use the virtual platform. Continuing Education (CE) Administration : Compile CE materials for all educational courses and meetings; submit materials for credit approval with the LSP Board of Registration, the Connecticut Licensed Environmental Professional (LEP) Board, and other Boards/entities; maintain CE records related to attendance, engagement, and evaluation; issue certificates of attendance to attendees; and attend monthly virtual LSP Board of Registration meetings. Sponsorship : Help administer the corporate and event sponsorship program, including updating the sponsorship prospectus, facilitating invoices/payments, maintaining contact lists, conducting outreach, and working with sponsors to access their sponsorship benefits. Member Service and Organizational Support : Help monitor and respond to inquiries received through the organization email inbox; provide customer service to members, sponsors, speakers, and event attendees; attend Board meetings, leadership meetings, and committee meetings as requested; and support association operations and special projects as needed. jobs.description: Company: Ocean Hotels Barbados SUMMARY: Performs a combination of tasks to maintain a high standard of cleanliness and orderliness in the hotel. To ensure guest rooms, working areas and the hotelâs premises in general in a clean and orderly manner. Duties And Responsibilities Operates in full compliance with the AAA 5 Diamond standards. Cleans and sanitized rugs, carpets, and upholstered furniture - using vacuum cleaner, broom, as necessary. Washes walls, ceilings, steps, patios, walkways, doors and window screens of the hotel rooms and public areas. Moves and arranges furniture, turns mattresses, hangs or removes fixtures, ornaments or pictures in guest rooms and offices as required. Sweeps, mops, scrubs, sanitized, waxes, and polishes floors and immediate surroundings including lounge cushions. Sweeps and scrubs corridors in front of guest rooms, removing any bottles. jobs.description: Description At ScionHealth , we empower our caregivers to do what they do best. We value every voice by caring deeply for every patient and each other. We show courage by running toward the challenge and we lean into new ideas by embracing curiosity and question asking. Together, we create our culture by living our values in our day-to-day interactions with our patients and teammates. Job Summary The Patient Access & Intake Coordinator plays a key role in facilitating a smooth and efficient patient admission process. This position provides vital administrative and operational support to the Business Development team and the Central Access and Authorizations Team (CAAT), ensuring timely initiation and management of referral activity. Responsible for launching the referral management process, the coordinator oversees admission workflows, gathers and verifies required documentation, coordinates information for necessary approvals, and communicates essential information to relevant departments. Acting as a central liaison between Business Development, facility leadership, and CAAT colleagues, this coordinates admission logistics, confirm readiness to receive the patient, and ensure all clinical and operational details are aligned prior to arrival. This role actively contributes to quality improvement, problem solving, and productivity initiatives within an interdisciplinary team model, demonstrating accountability and a commitment to operational excellence. Essential Functions Serves as key team member of the new Central Access and Authorizations Team (CAAT), focused exclusively on intake of referrals and building the initial case for patient admission. Responsible for initiating any patient referral by establishing patient account in appropriate referral management platform Performs a wide variety of typing assignments, including entering demographic information into referral platform and/or Meditech for admission Works with business development team to gather patient information, admission and facility details from multiple referral platforms and sources Validates data and enters complete details into referral platform, establishing the foundation for successful benefit verification, initial prior authorization and ultimate patient admission Manages the entry of care transition program referrals into appropriate platform and working with business development team to manage those referrals Supports the business development team in coordinating the admission of the patient by coordinating bed assignments and any necessary admission paperwork, in collaborating with designated owner at the facility. Confirms that insurance verification / auth is complete Validates patient account and profile and PIC days in appropriate systems of record Communicates specific patient needs for bed, equipment, supplies, pharmacy, and consult services based on information received from business development team Provides hospital team with needed information on pending/new admissions Coordinates bed availability with facility house supervisor Responsible for working with the business development team to maintain accuracy and integrity of the pending referral log in the referral platform, which may include: Review and reconciliation of referral log reports Review and reconciliation of patient accounts in referral management systems Participates in continuing education/ professional development activities Learns and develops full knowledge of the CAAT Admission Processes and actively seeks to continuously improve them. jobs.title: Chief of Staff the CEO
jobs.description: The job in one line You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet. Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running. That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat. What You'll Actually Do Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for. Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires. Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time. Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them. Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan. Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say. What Success Looks Like In 90 Days Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business Requirements What we're looking for 8 to 12 years of experience, including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. jobs.description: At Total Care Connections , our mission is to enrich lives by providing compassionate, high-quality home care that empowers individuals to live safely and independently. We believe that exceptional care begins with supporting the dedicated employees who make our mission possible. As a Payroll and Benefits Assistant, you play an essential role in ensuring our team members are paid accurately, have access to the benefits they need, and receive the timely support that helps them feel valued . Your attention to detail and commitment to service directly contribute to a positive employee experience, allowing our caregivers and staff to focus on delivering outstanding care to those we serve. Position Summary The HR Assistant supports the Payroll & Benefits Department by processing and validating employee information that feeds payroll and benefits administration. Serving as the first checkpoint in the payroll process, this role helps ensure employee changes are complete, accurate, approved, and submitted on time. Key Responsibilities Payroll and Employee Data Support Validate time and attendance, PTO, leave, and employee records before each payroll cycle. Process approved new hire, termination, compensation, transfer, promotion, and leave-of-absence changes. Enter approved benefits deduction changes and maintain supporting documentation. Conduct routine employee data audits, correct inaccuracies, and escalate unresolved discrepancies before payroll deadlines. Provide the Payroll and Benefits Specialists with complete and accurate information for each processing cycle. Employee Lifecycle And Benefits Support Support onboarding and separation processes, including employee record setup, benefits eligibility, access-removal coordination, and required benefits continuation notifications. Track benefits eligibility and enrollment milestones and maintain applicable eligibility lists. Prepare employment verification letters and other routine employee correspondence. Respond to general employee questions and escalate payroll or benefits concerns as appropriate. International Payroll Support Review international time and attendance records and support employee and contractor payment readiness. Identify absences, unpaid time, missing information, and other payroll-impacting discrepancies before applicable deadlines. Qualifications One to two years of experience in HR administration, payroll support, benefits administration, or a related role. Strong attention to detail, organization, and comfort working within recurring deadlines. Experience using HR, payroll, benefits, timekeeping, or employee data-management systems. Ability to handle confidential employee, payroll, and benefits information with discretion. Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues appropriately. Strong written communication skills and comfort supporting U.S. and international team members. If our mission resonates with you and you're passionate about supporting the employees who make our care possible, we'd love to hear from you! jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Qualification Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Planet, we launch spacecraft early and often. From technology demonstrators to operational constellations, exceptional engineers are needed to design, manufacture, test and launch spacecraft. This role offers a unique opportunity for an engineer to take ownership of environmental testing activities supporting spacecraft production and delivery.</p> <p>As a Senior Spacecraft Qualification Engineer, you will serve as the primary mechanical and environmental test engineering authority at our Berlin manufacturing site. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hands-on work and thrives in ambiguity, with deep technical expertise, quick engineering judgment, and the ability to independently assess and resolve complex test situations while ensuring the safety of personnel and flight hardware. Coming from a dynamic aerospace environment, having completed challenging environmental test campaigns while collaborating effectively with R&amp;D, systems, and manufacturing teams will be a solid advantage.</p> <p>This is a full-time, in-office position based in our Berlin office 5 days per week. Occasional travel should be expected as part of testing and integration operations.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <p>Own environmental test execution and respond to off-nominal events:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Review environmental test requirements, procedures, and readiness packages for spacecraft acceptance and protoflight campaigns.</li> <li>Serve as the primary technical authority during test operations including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, and thermal vacuum test operations.</li> <li>Perform hands-on operations including instrumentation setup, inspections, test monitoring, and hardware troubleshooting.</li> <li>Assess test data in real time to identify failures, anomalies, or unexpected hardware responses.</li> <li>Develop and implement technically sound recovery plans while preserving personnel safety, facility safety, and hardware integrity.</li> </ul> <p>Ensure test readiness and facility capability:</p> <ul> <li>Validate test configurations, instrumentation plans, facility readiness, and hardware constraints prior to test execution.</li> <li>Coordinate with technicians and cross-functional teams to ensure safe and efficient execution of environmental test campaigns.</li

jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager - EMEA West
jobs.description: You must be located in Europe to be considered for this position and are available for occasional travel to our Munich, Germany office. Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology. In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work." We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale. About the Role: Tulip is expanding fast across international markets, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You build demand in regions where we are still establishing the brand, with real room to shape how Tulip shows up and wins. This is full ownership of the marketing plan for your region, not a slice of the funnel. You own or co-manage one or more regions: the account programs, the field events, and the pipeline that comes from them. You are the lynchpin between your region and the commercial organization, working alongside sales, BDRs, and partners to build go-to-market motions that convert target accounts. You continuously iterate on which programs and accounts work, optimize spend across your region, and own the plan from strategy to execution without waiting on a hand-off. jobs.title: Brand & Content Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: JOIN US Du schreibst gerne, hast ein gutes Gespür für Marken und kannst komplexes Wissen so aufbereiten, dass Menschen es wirklich verstehen? Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu Dir passen. Für unser Marketing-Team suchen wir eine:n Brand & Content Marketing Manager:in auf Mid-Level. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Content, der nach Code Gaia aussieht, nach Code Gaia klingt und Vertrauen in unsere Marke und Expertise aufbaut. Viele unserer Inhalte sind einer der ersten Berührungspunkte mit Code Gaia. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass sie nicht nur fachlich richtig sind, sondern auch verständlich, nahbar und visuell konsistent umgesetzt werden. WHAT YOU DO Du entwickelst Content-Ideen aus aktuellen Marktsignalen und häufigen Fragen unserer Zielgruppen. In einem monatlichen Austausch mit unserem Sustainability Team greifst Du relevantes Expert:innenwissen auf und übersetzt es in verständlichen Content. Du erstellst unter anderem Blogartikel, LinkedIn-Posts, Newsletter, Landingpages, Website-Texte und Sales-Enablement-Content. Du führst Gespräche mit Kund:innen und entwickelst daraus glaubwürdige Case Studies für unsere Website und weitere Kanäle. Du denkst Content multichannel: Aus einem Thema können beispielsweise ein Blogartikel, mehrere LinkedIn-Posts, ein Newsletter oder ein Webinar entstehen. Du pflegst Inhalte in WordPress und setzt E-Mails, Formulare, Listen und einfache Kampagnen in HubSpot um. Du wertest relevante Content- und Kampagnenkennzahlen aus und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team Verbesserungen daraus ab. Ergänzend planst und begleitest Du ausgewählte Webinare, Messen und Events – von der Kommunikation bis zur Nachbereitung. WHO YOU ARE Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Content Marketing, Brand Marketing oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle Sehr gute schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit und echte Freude am Schreiben Ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling, Tonalität und Markenwirkung Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen schnell zu erfassen und verständlich aufzubereiten Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Content-Formaten und Kanälen Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise Einen reflektierten Umgang mit KI-Tools: Du nutzt sie sinnvoll, kannst Inhalte aber auch eigenständig entwickeln und redaktionell beurteilen Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Nice to have Erfahrung mit HubSpot, WordPress, Bricks oder ClickUp Ein gutes Auge für Design und die Fähigkeit, mit Canva einfache Visual Assets für LinkedIn, Webinare oder Case Studies zu erstellen Erfahrung im Podcastschnitt, zum Beispiel mit Audacity oder Riverside Erste Erfahrung mit Webinaren, Messen oder anderen Events WHAT TO EXPECT So arbeitest Du bei uns Die Rolle ist auf Mid-Level angesiedelt. Das bedeutet, dass Du Deine eigenen Themen und Projekte selbstständig steuerst und Verantwortung für eine zuverlässige Umsetzung übernimmst. Gleichzeitig bist Du Teil eines Teams, in dem wir gemeinsam an Content arbeiten, Ideen diskutieren und uns gegenseitig unterstützen. Du musst nicht unsere gesamte Content-Strategie allein entwickeln oder jeden Inhalt von Anfang bis Ende selbst umsetzen. Übergreifende Prioritäten und strategische Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam beziehungsweise in Abstimmung mit der Teamleitung. Wir wünschen uns aber, dass Du mitdenkst, gute Fragen stellst, Verbesserungspotenziale erkennst und Deine eigenen Themen aktiv vorantreibst. Du wartest nicht nur auf fertige Briefings, sondern gehst proaktiv auf die Menschen zu, deren Wissen oder Feedback Du für Deine Arbeit brauchst. Content entsteht bei uns nicht im stillen Kämmerlein. Wir entwickeln Ideen gemeinsam, geben uns Feedback und unterstützen einander. Für Deine eigenen Themen übernimmst Du aber den redaktionellen Lead und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee veröffentlichungsreifer Content wird. Code Gaia bietet flexible, hybride Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, Mitsprache und individueller Förderung von Wachstum. Dazu kommen moderne Arbeitsprozesse, ein faires Gehalt mit Wachstum

Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. Instead of recycling generic job postings, we work directly with hiring companies to understand what a role really requires, then match candidates on demonstrated skills and mindset rather than job titles, degrees, or CV pedigree. Our process combines structured, AI-supported matching with a human review at every step, so no decision about a candidate is ever made by an algorithm alone. If you have worked in an early-stage or startup environment before, the pace and the level of ownership will feel familiar. Your Role You keep Sales and Operations running cleanly behind the scenes, so the team can focus on clients and candidates instead of chasing down data. This is an operational role built on concrete, recurring tasks: CRM administration, pipeline tracking, market research, and digital information management. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About Userlane Userlane is a market-leading Digital Adoption Platform that empowers organisations to understand and improve the value of their technology investments. Working with some of the world's most recognisable enterprises, we identify and eliminate adoption barriers and produce a more engaging and productive software experience for employees. Your mission Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as: Defining metrics that hold up : Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete. Delivering outcome-linked metrics : Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on Building for time-poor executives : Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?" Connecting fragmented data sources : Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems, Transforming insights into action : Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once AI adoption governance : Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI. Your profile 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't. You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?" You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does. You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike You're fluent in English (spoken and written) What's in for you Team & Culture : A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems Product strategy influence : Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors Market : Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry Growth : We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training Benefits : We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. Together, we’ve fulfilled over 20 million deliveries (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination.  ⚙️Technology at Bloom & Wild Our Technology team of over 60 people sits right at the heart of our business. We build and maintain the solutions that power e-commerce, production and fulfilment, enabling our brands to delight our customers every day. The Product Engineering team consists of five cross-functional squads who each lead their own business and architectural domain, and are supported by our Platform, Domain Engineering, Data and IT teams. Our platform uses technologies including Ruby and Rails and Python/ React, backed by PostgreSQL, Fargate/ECS on AWS, and Cloud Run on GCP. It exposes APIs that are used by our multi-brand Angular webapp and our native iOS and Android mobile apps.  We’re also looking at developing new domain driven services & microservices where applicable. Most of our team is based in the UK or The Netherlands and works in a flexible model, with choice in how often they travel to the office. Our squads meet in person at least once per quarter in order to maintain connections, collaborate on larger projects and have fun together. You can read lots more about our technology stack and our culture over on our tech blog - Code & Wild 💻 What you’ll be doing As a Platform Engineer you'll work across the whole of Technology (Frontend, Backend, Data Engineering, Data Science and Warehouse Tech) helping other engineers ship better, faster, and more safely. You'll split your time roughly equally between embedded engagements inside domain squads and central platform work on the shared infrastructure. The role of an engineer is changing. AI has removed writing code as the scarce skill ; the valuable engineer is the one who picks the right problems, scopes them, and owns them through to how they behave in production. This role leans into that shift. You will work with a high degree of independence and the work isn't always handed to you as ready-made tickets, so you'll have space to identify, shape and deliver on solutions end-to-end. This includes: Embedded Engagements : Partner with domain squads, shipping code and tools to directly enhance their capability and solve real problems. Paved Roads : Build shared, adoption-driven infrastructure like feature flags, canary rollouts, fast builds, and CI/CD patterns. Making the easiest path the best path. AI Integration : Extend AI across the engineering lifecycle (ticket generation, config authoring, incident response, code review), operating with AI as your core working mode and creating reusable patterns. Core Infrastructure : Maintain and evolve shared services: AWS, GitHub, Datadog, Cloudflare, distributing ownership across the Platform team. jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager - EMEA West
jobs.description: You must be located in Europe to be considered for this position and are available for occasional travel to our Munich, Germany office. Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology. In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work." We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale. About the Role: Tulip is expanding fast across international markets, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You build demand in regions where we are still establishing the brand, with real room to shape how Tulip shows up and wins. This is full ownership of the marketing plan for your region, not a slice of the funnel. You own or co-manage one or more regions: the account programs, the field events, and the pipeline that comes from them. You are the lynchpin between your region and the commercial organization, working alongside sales, BDRs, and partners to build go-to-market motions that convert target accounts. You continuously iterate on which programs and accounts work, optimize spend across your region, and own the plan from strategy to execution without waiting on a hand-off. You have a high ceiling, are full of ideas, analytically rigorous, and wired to see your work drive real outcomes. You are motivated to both sell and build with AI, and here you use it to produce, test, and iterate faster than a traditional team can. What skills do I need? 8-10+ years of experience in go-to-market, regional marketing, or partner marketing, with a record of owning outcomes rather than completing tasks. Experience running account- and journey-based programs against a defined target account list, from campaign build to pipeline attribution. Track record collaborating with BDRs, AEs, and partners on target accounts through structured programs: joint account planning, account prioritization, and coordinated outreach against a shared pipeline target. Regional market fluency: adapting messaging and programs to local buying behavior, language, and market norms. Analytical rigor: you understand pipeline math, read a campaign performance report, and tell signal from noise. Low ego, high accountability: you would rather learn what works than be right. Key Responsibilities: Own and carry pipeline targets for one or more regions. Build and own the regional marketing plan and account segmentation across core and ABM channels. Understand regional industries and target personas, then define content needs and formats and drive production and localization. Build and run account-based programs against target accounts, coordinating campaigns and outreach with BDRs and AEs. Run or support conferences and regional field events from planning through pipeline attribution. Use AI to produce, test, and iterate on assets and campaigns at higher volume. Key Collaborators: Regional Sales leadership BDRs and Accoun

Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. The person in this position should have the ability and confidence to close deals and ensure a smooth handoff to the appropriate teams after deal closure. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Cloud Governance Platform team. This team builds the foundational platforms that enforce governance, identity security, compliance, and software supply-chain protections across all of Samsara's cloud infrastructure and developer environments. Rather than relying on manual reviews or policy enforcement, this team delivers secure, compliant-by-default systems through cloud IAM guardrails, automated controls, and scalable platform abstractions across AWS and GCP. As a Senior Engineer you will contribute hands-on to systems that need to be reliable and secure at scale, taking ownership of your components end-to-end. You will bring strong engineering judgment to design discussions, while looking to senior/staff engineers and your manager for guidance on cross-team tradeoffs. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations. You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together. In this role, you will:   Design and build core components of Samsara's Cloud Governance Platform, contributing hands-on to cloud IAM, security controls, compliance enforcement, and software supply-chain security capabilities. Contribute to the roadmap for governance and security tooling across AWS and GCP, bringing engineering judgment to prioritization discussions. Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into automated, continuously enforced controls through direct implementation. Build and maintain software supply-chain security tooling, including SAST, DAST, and secure CI/CD pipeline patterns. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, and Product Engineering teams to implement solutions for cross-functional risk and governance problems. Share technical knowledge with teammates

jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with current support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, and Python. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.  Know the Why : We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.  Innovate & Iterate : We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. Who You Are We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. As a Lead SRE, you'll be a technical and operational leader for reliability across Develocity. You'll help define our SRE vision, set standards for how we operate production services, and mentor other SREs as the team grows. This is a hands-on role with broad influence across engineering, cloud platform, and customer-facing teams. The SRE team will be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries. You'll work on our internally-built Cloud Application Platform, Kubernetes on AWS, and develop deep expertise in it. When incidents happen, you'll troubleshoot issues across the stack, from application to infrastructure. You'll collaborate with the Cloud Platform team to improve the tooling you depend on, and with engineering teams to build reliability into how we ship software. If you like automating things and hate doing the same task twice, you'll fit in well. You'll be part of a distributed, remote-first team that values asynchronous communication and written documentation. Strong self-direction and clear communication across time zones are essential. Responsibilities Operate and maintain all Develocity instances and supporting services in production. Define and evolve SRE standards, practices, and operating models, including on-call, incident response, postmortems, and SLOs. Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, acting as a technical escalation point for complex or high-severity incidents. Lead incident response and blameless r

jobs.title: (Senior) CRM / Lifecycle Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Retention entscheidet, ob aus dem ersten Kauf eine Beziehung über das ganze Hunde- und Katzenleben wird und genau dieses Spielfeld gehört Dir. Du bekommst Ownership über Lifecycle CRM bei 7 starken Petfood-Marken : Du verantwortest unsere Automations und Kampagnen von der Idee bis zum Go-Live - mit modernen Tools, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Impact. Du arbeitest selbstständig, triffst Entscheidungen und verbesserst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Du baust, betreust und optimierst Klaviyo-Flows und -Kampagnen für alle 7 Marken parallel (u.a. Wolfsblut, Herrmann's Manufaktur, pets Premium) - vom Welcome Flow bis zur Reaktivierung. Du verantwortest E-Mail als Kernkanal . Weitere Kanäle wie Print-Mailings, WhatsApp, SMS und RCS bauen wir perspektivisch aus - hier bringst Du kanalübergreifendes Denken ein. Du bringst Maßnahmen eigenständig live und iterierst auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Geschwindigkeit vor Perfektion : Du testest, misst und schärfst schnell nach. Du machst aus Daten konkrete Maßnahmen: RFM, Segmente, Produkt- und Engagement-Daten, Tierprofile, Predictions (Rebuy, CLV, Churn) werden bei Dir zu personalisierter, relevanter Ansprache. Storytelling ist Deine Stärke : Bei Produktion und Skalierung unterstützen Dich moderne Tools und Automatisierung - Du bringst die zündende Hookline, das initiale Design-Briefing und die emotionale Ansprache aufs leere Blatt. Du setzt AI- und Automatisierungstools selbstverständlich ein, um schneller von der Idee zum Live-Test zu kommen und mehr Zeit für Konzept und Creative zu gewinnen. Du kommunizierst Ergebnisse klar und auf den Punkt - intern wie mit unseren Marken-Stakeholdern und du arbeitest als Sparring-Partner auf Augenhöhe. Was Du mitbringst Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung im CRM-/Lifecycle-Marketing mit messbaren Ergebnissen , idealerweise im E-Commerce/D2C. Sehr gute praktische Klaviyo-Kenntnisse (oder vergleichbare Marketing-Automation-Plattform). Du denkst in Customer Journeys und verstehst Retention-Mechaniken (Rebuy, CLV, Churn). AI-native Arbeiten ist für Dich selbstverständlich : Du setzt LLMs, n8n, Cursor und ähnliche Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein. Du baust selbst : Flows, Segmente und Templates entstehen in Deinen Händen. Du bringst sie eigenständig live, lernst aus Ergebnissen und iterierst schnell. Segmentierung, Trigger, A/B-Tests und Deliverability beherrschst Du sicher. Mit Consent und Datenschutz (DSGVO) gehst Du selbstverständlich sauber und verantwortungsvoll um. Du bist datengetrieben und übersetzt unsere Looker-Dashboards in konkrete Maßnahmen. Kreatives Gespür: Du setzt ein Briefing aus dem Nichts auf und bringst eine Kampagne mit einer starken Hookline auf den Punkt. Du verstehst den Zusammenhang zwischen Creative und Performance. Kategorie-Empathie für Copy und Creative : Du kannst Dich in die Perspektive von Tierhalter:innen hineinversetzen - und das zeigt sich in Deiner Ansprache. Was wir Dir bieten Verantwortungsvolle, spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen Unternehmen , das flache Hierarchien und eine offene, lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre lebt, in der alle per "Du" sind Ein freundliches, offenes Team bestehend aus ca. 280 Mitarbeitenden in München, Leipzig und Albourne (UK) mit mehreren lieben Bürohunden an unseren Standorten Flexible Arbeitszeiten (die auf Vertrauensarbeitszeit basieren), Home-Office Optionen inkl. Kostenbeteiligung an Deiner Home-Office Ausstattung und die Möglichkeit, für mehrere Monate aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten 28 Tage Urlaubsanspruc h sowie die Möglichkeit, bis zu 20 Tage unbezahlten Urlaub sowie Sonderurlaub zu nehmen! Verschiedene interne & externe Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten , die Du eigenständig nach Deinen Interessen auswählen kannst Deine mentale Gesundheit ist uns wichtig! Deshalb kannst Du im Rahmen der Plattform " OpenUp " anonym an Einzel- oder Gruppentherapie-Sitzungen teilnehmen oder in 1:1 Meetings mit echten Therapeuten

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter (f/m/d) Remote Germany
jobs.description: The role in brief You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before. Why this role exists selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously. We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step. This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable. What you will work on Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards Must-haves Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication Nice-to-haves Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles How we work selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.

Our software platform uses artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and edge computing to provide real-time situational awareness for air, land, and sea domains, enabling rapid decisions at machine speed. We offer creative freedom, competitive compensation, and a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions truly matter. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you. Responsibilities: You will define the target end-to-end architecture together with prospective insurance customers and guide them from the initial technical analysis through to the signed solution agreement. You will present architectural concepts and technical roadmaps convincingly to C-level stakeholders (CTOs, CIOs, CDOs) and act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner for both technical and business decision-makers. You will drive technical transformation within the Customer Delivery organization by standardizing architectural practices, introducing modern cloud and SaaS patterns, and enabling delivery teams. You will serve as a mentor and technical anchor for Solution Architects and Customer Delivery Managers throughout the entire project lifecycle. You will document architectural decisions, requirements, and technical concepts, ensuring long-term knowledge sharing and retention within the Customer Delivery organization. You will be responsible for technical communication with all stakeholders—both internal and external—keeping everyone consistently informed and aligned. jobs.title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig. Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften. 📍 Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell. Was Du machst: Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen. Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst. Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust. Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen. Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen. Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist. Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind. Was Du mitbringst: Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen. Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht. Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften. Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen. Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir Dir bieten: • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag.   • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.   • Internationales Arbeitsumfel

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.   We're looking for a motivated and skilled  Senior Data Scientist   to join our  Team Greenrock  – Demand Division .   Our Tech team owns Flix's  Revenue Management System  (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management.   This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience.   About the Role Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries. Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout. Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams. Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system.   About You Education and Revenue Management  expertise (must-have) Advanced degree ( Master's or PhD ) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics , or a related quantitative field Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management. Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus.   Engineering and data craft   Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets. Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production.   Soft skills   Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions. Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system.   We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!   What We Offer Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.  Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.  Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.  Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.  Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.  Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.  To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link:  Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot)
jobs.description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Berlin . At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us to let our consumers maximize value for their money by providing a world-class shopping rewards experience online and in-store, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys. Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc. Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap. Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency. Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively. Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.   Your Profile: We're looking for someone with 6+ years of experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation. 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side. Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot . Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems. Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular. Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure). Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts. Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns. Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills. Passion for delivering clean code
